# Quran API v4

> Static Quran JSON dataset (Arabic, English, Bengali, audio, images, tafsir) served via jsDelivr CDN. No authentication required.

## Base URL

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nhridoy/quran-api@latest/v4
```

Every endpoint has `.json` (pretty) and `.min.json` (minified) variants.

## Supporting Files

| File | CDN URL |
|------|---------|
| Reciter list | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nhridoy/quran-api@latest/v4/reciters.json` |
| Hadith editions | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nhridoy/quran-api@latest/v4/hadith/editions.json` |
| TypeScript types | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nhridoy/quran-api@latest/v4/quran.d.ts` |
| Hadith types | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nhridoy/quran-api@latest/v4/hadith.d.ts` |
| Full docs | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nhridoy/quran-api@latest/v4/README.md` |

## Endpoints

### Verse Text (Arabic + translations)

`/v4/surah/verse/{id}.json` (id: 1–114)

- **Surah header**: `no`, `name`, `enName`, `enNameTranslation`, `bnNameTranslation`, `revelationType`, `revelationOrder`, `numberOfAyahs`
- **Per verse**: `totalNumber`, `numberInSurah`, `juz`, `sajda {recommended, obligatory}`, `text {arText, enText, enTextTransliteration, bnText, bntextLatin}`

### Verse Images

`/v4/surah/image/{id}.json`

- **Per verse**: `image {primary, secondary, alternative, alternative-high}`

### Audio by Reciter

`/v4/surah/audio/{reciter}/{id}.json`

- **Per verse**: `audio {primary (128k), secondary (64k), tertiary, alternative}`
- **Reciters**: `ar.abdullahbasfar`, `ar.abdurrahmaansudais`, `ar.abdulsamad`, `ar.ahmedajamy`, `ar.alafasy`, `ar.aymanswoaid`, `ar.hanirifai`, `ar.hudhaify`, `ar.husary`, `ar.husarymujawwad`, `ar.ibrahimakhbar`, `ar.mahermuaiqly`, `ar.muhammadayyoub`, `ar.muhammadjibreel`, `ar.parhizgar`, `ar.saoodshuraym`, `ar.shaatree`
- **Full reciter data**: `reciters.json`

### Juz/Para (grouped by juz/part, all 4 categories)

`/v4/juz/{category}/{id}.json` (id: 1–30)

Same 4 categories as surah endpoints (`verse`, `image`, `audio/{reciter}`, `tafsir/{lang}/{id}`). Each juz groups verses across multiple surahs.

- **Wrapper**: `juzNumber`, `verseMapping` (surah → verse range), `totalVerse`, `surah` (array)
- **Per-verse schemas**: identical to surah endpoints

### Tafsir (18 works across 6 languages)

`/v4/surah/tafsir/{lang}/{tafsir-id}/{id}.json`

- **Languages**: `ar` (7), `bn` (4), `en` (2), `ku` (1), `ru` (1), `ur` (3)
- **Per verse**: `lang`, `authorName`, `tafsirName`, `tafsir` (HTML)

### Hadith

`/v4/hadith/editions.json`

- **Editions**: 8 major hadith collections with multi-language support
- **Languages**: `ar`, `en`, `bn`, `fr`, `tr`, `ur`, `id`, `ta`, `ru`, `ar-diacritics`

`/v4/hadith/{edition-slug}/books.json`

- **Books**: List of books within an edition, with hadith count per book

`/v4/hadith/{edition-slug}/{edition-slug}-{book-index}/{lang-code}/hadith.json`

- **Hadith**: All hadith entries for a specific book in a language
- **Per hadith**: `id`, `editionId`, `bookIndex`, `hadithIndex`, `bookHadithIndex`, `text`, `grades`

`/v4/hadith/{edition-slug}/{edition-slug}-{book-index}/{lang-code}/{page}.json`

- **Paginated hadith**: Same structure as above, with `total`, `totalPage`, `page`, `pageSize`

## TypeScript Types

`quran.d.ts` — `SurahHeader`, `SurahVerseText`, `SurahImage`, `SurahAudio`, `SurahTafsir`, `ReciterKey`, `ReciterInfo`, `RecitersList`, `TafsirId`, `TafsirLanguage`

`hadith.d.ts` — `HadithEdition`, `HadithBook`, `HadithEntry`, `HadithGrade`, `HadithCollection`, `PaginatedHadithCollection`

## Key Differences from v2

- Text fields grouped under `text` object (not flat)
- Added `revelationOrder` at surah level
- 18 tafsir works across 6 languages
- 17 reciters with 4 audio quality tiers each
- Verse images with 4 quality tiers
- Data split into 4 independent category endpoints

## Build Scripts

`/v4/build-fetch.js` — builds surah data (verse, image, audio, tafsir)
`/v4/build-para.js` — builds juz/para data from existing surah data
